title: Azure architecture diagram skill bundle manifest
description: Bundle file list + version metadata for the skill shipped to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor). Adapters fetch this file first and iterate `files` to install each entry.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor validation. Optional at runtime.

name.description: Skill name. MUST match the `name` field in SKILL.md frontmatter and the destination folder under ~/.claude/skills/.

version.description: SemVer version of this skill bundle. MUST match SKILL.md frontmatter `version` and packages/cli/package.json `version`.

requires_icons.description: SemVer range of compatible icon-set releases (e.g. '>=0.2.2'). CLI verifies before install.

files.description: Bundle file list. Index 0 MUST be SKILL.md so the install-time frontmatter precheck has a stable target.

src.description: Path inside this repository (POSIX, relative to repo root). Used as the GitHub raw URL suffix.

dest.description: Path inside the destination skill folder under ~/.claude/skills/<name>/. POSIX.

role.description: `skill` for the top-level SKILL.md. `example` for entries under examples/. Adapters MAY treat roles differently.
